themes.name: Housing Affordability and Supply
themes.rule: Includes proposals that create, convert, regulate, renovate, subsidize, or make information available about residential housing, rents, and student accommodation.

themes.name: School Education Support
themes.rule: Includes proposals focused on school-age pupils, teachers, classrooms, school facilities, school meals, tutoring, or children's arts instruction.

themes.name: Health and Care Access
themes.rule: Includes proposals that expand healthcare, preventive screening, mental-health services, specialist access, or care for older residents.

themes.name: Public Transit Service
themes.rule: Includes proposals concerning bus operations, transit arrival information, service frequency, late-night service, or transit fares.

themes.name: Street Safety and Active Travel
themes.rule: Includes proposals that redesign or light streets, crossings, footpaths, or cycling routes to make walking and cycling safer.

themes.name: Municipal Access and Transparency
themes.rule: Includes proposals that make city services, municipal information, public internet access, or resident assistance easier to access through online, phone, or in-person channels.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Small Business
themes.rule: Includes proposals that support workers, local hiring, career retraining, business licensing, small-business finance, or workspaces for independent workers.

themes.name: Waste and Pollution Reduction
themes.rule: Includes proposals focused on recycling, composting, reducing disposable plastics, or monitoring air pollution.

themes.name: Green Infrastructure and Clean Energy
themes.rule: Includes proposals that add renewable energy, trees, nearby parks, or shared land for growing food.

themes.name: Culture and Recreation Amenities
themes.rule: Includes proposals providing cultural activities, public art, museums, libraries, playgrounds, or dog recreation areas.

themes.name: Emergency and Crime Safety
themes.rule: Includes proposals that improve emergency-service response, neighborhood policing, or surveillance for crime prevention.
